component.name: dbcode
component.description: Database client for VS Code, Cursor & Windsurf with first-class Copilot & MCP integration. 80+ databases, SQL Notebooks, ER diagrams, data editing, secure sharing. A modern alternative to DBeaver, DataGrip & TablePlus - inside your editor.

properties.name: dbcode:scope
properties.value: Production dependency closure as resolved from pnpm-lock.yaml, covering every platform DBCode ships to rather than the one that generated this file. Build and test tooling is excluded. The shipped bundle is a tree-shaken subset of this list.

properties.name: dbcode:runtimeDownloads
properties.value: teradatasql, koffi from registry.npmjs.org (First Teradata connection) | dmdb, iconv-lite, safer-buffer from registry.npmjs.org (First Dameng connection) | @sap/hana-client from registry.npmjs.org (First SAP HANA connection) | @duckdb, @lancedb, @libsql native builds from registry.npmjs.org (First DuckDB, LanceDB or libSQL connection) | JDBC drivers (Access, Derby, H2, IBM i, SAP ASE) from repo1.maven.org (First connection to that engine) | aerospike-jdbc from github.com/aerospike (First Aerospike connection) | node-ibm_db from github.com/ibmdb (First Db2 connection) | kerberos from github.com/mongodb-js (Kerberos authentication) | mod_spatialite from github.com/dbcodeio (SQLite spatial functions) | better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers, sqlite-vec from github.com/dbcodeio/public (Encrypted SQLite or SQLite vector search) | mongodb-database-tools from fastdl.mongodb.org (MongoDB import, export, backup or restore) | sqlpackage from download.microsoft.com (SQL Server import or export) | PG Tools (pg_dump, pg_restore, psql) from get.enterprisedb.com (PostgreSQL backup, restore or import. Windows and macOS only; Linux uses the tools on PATH) | Visual C++ redistributable from aka.ms (Windows only, for native drivers that require it)
